en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with three inset photographs framed by ornate floral decoration. Two images show the interior of a large festively decorated hall with long banquet tables laid for many guests. The third image shows the exterior of a grand historicist building labeled 'TIVOLI' on its facade. Printed German text on the right identifies the location as the concert and ballroom 'Tivoli' in Freiberg in Saxony and mentions the proprietor.
